findings.title: A resumed run re-creates a PR GitHub already has: openPr trusts the saved s.pr (Fresh Read Rule)
findings.why: The new early return in checkAndPush (line 361) and openPr are meant to carry on a branch that was pushed but whose PR wasn't opened. openPr decides there's no PR only from the local note (`if (!s.pr)`) and runs `gh pr create` again. If the first `gh pr create` opened the PR on GitHub but the runner didn't record it (gh errored or timed out after creating it, or the process died before save), every `/agent retry` on the ticket fails again with 'a pull request for branch already exists', and the ticket can't resume. Rule 7 says GitHub wins over a saved note. openPr should look up the branch's open PR (`gh pr list --head <branch>`) and use it before creating one. Also, the resume loop skips any ticket whose s.pr is unset but that has a live PR, and never sends it down the PR path.

findings.title: resumePlan compares two different timestamp formats as strings
findings.why: `a.at > s.stoppedAt` compares GitHub's created_at ('…T22:00:05Z', whole seconds) with toISOString() ('…T22:00:05.900Z') as strings. Within the same second, 'Z' sorts after '.', so a retry posted in the stop's second counts as after the stop even when it came before. Parse both with Date.parse before comparing. The local clock and GitHub's can also drift apart.

findings.title: After a re-ask times out, /agent retry can never ask Qodo again
findings.why: When Qodo doesn't start a new run within reviewWaitMin after the re-ask, the run stops with 'Qodo hadn't started a new review'. s.reasked still holds {head, run}, so after an owner `/agent retry` on the PR, reaskPlan returns 'wait' (same head, same run id). It never posts /review again and times out a second time. That stop message, unlike the 'twice' one, doesn't tell the owner to ask Qodo by hand first.

findings.title: The qodo-gate status shows failure while the runner waits for the re-asked review
findings.why: For an incomplete review, gate() posts a 'NOT DONE' failure status before reaskPlan decides to re-ask and wait. The PR shows failed for up to reviewWaitMin while the run is still waiting, not pending.

findings.title: Every tick logs that a resume is waiting on an open PR
findings.why: While another PR is open, a pending `/agent retry` on the ticket adds the same 'waits: PR #x is still open' event every 10-minute tick. The ready loop does the same, so the log fills up while a PR is under review.
